subject: Procurement follow-up: PO vs Card & marketplace for Orion Labs
messages:
From: Logan Wright <logan@redwood.com>
To: Dana Lee <dana@orionlabs.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 02 Oct 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo recap + procurement checklist (PO vs card)

Hi Dana and Maya —

Thanks again for taking time today. Quick recap and the action items we discussed so your AP team can evaluate onboarding options. Main decision centers on whether Orion will onboard via:

- Purchase Order (standard procurement path, Net 30/60 invoicing)
- Corporate card / P-card (instant charges, faster provisioning)
- Marketplace (AWS/GCP/Azure marketplace listing to leverage cloud billing)

Key notes from the call:
- Orion prefers centralized AP and typically processes vendor invoices via PO when total > $5k.
- They are open to using a card for pilot credit but need internal approval for long-term card usage.
- Security and vendor evidence (SOC2, data residency notes) were requested by the procurement team.

Action items:
1) I will attach a short AP checklist (fields AP will need: invoice remit, W9, PO terms, preferred billing contact).
2) Vivek will follow up on technical integration notes for marketplace compatibility.
3) Marissa — can you confirm our standard MSA + invoicing language and whether we can accommodate net-45 as an exception?
4) Dana/Maya — please share the procurement contact (name/email) and any vendor onboarding portal link you use.

Attachments: Orion_AP_Checklist.xlsx (spreadsheet stub)

Thanks —
Logan Wright
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
logan@redwood.com | +1-415-555-0133

--
Redwood Inference | high-performance LLM inference for production
From: Dana Lee <dana@orionlabs.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan@redwood.com>
Cc: Maya Patel <maya@orionlabs.com>
Date: Fri, 02 Oct 2026 17:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo recap + procurement checklist (PO vs card)

Thanks Logan — helpful recap. A few quick clarifications from our side:

- Confirming Orion’s AP policy: default is PO for purchases over $2,500. For pilots under $2,500 we can use a corporate card but it requires approval from Finance (we'll need a line item and justification).
- Our billing team is centralized in Ops:
  - Contact: Priya Natarajan (priya.n@orionlabs.com)
  - Portal: https://procurement.orionlabs.com/vendor-onboard (they use a vendor portal where we can upload W9s and certificates)
- Security evidence: we need SOC2 Type II and run-of-show for data retention; a short vendor questionnaire is attached to the portal.

We are interested in marketplace only if it simplifies internal chargebacks to engineering teams — otherwise PO is fine.

I'll put Priya on a short intro email if that helps.

—Dana
Dana Lee
Head of Finance Operations, Orion Labs
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan@redwood.com>, Dana Lee <dana@orionlabs.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 03 Oct 2026 09:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo recap + procurement checklist (PO vs card)

Hi Dana (and team) —

Thanks — looping in a couple of operational clarifications so your AP team can triage quickly:

- MSA & Invoicing: attached is our standard MSA (redwood_msa_draft_v1.docx). For most mid-market deals we accept Net 30. Net 45 is possible but requires approval from Revenue Ops; please let us know if Finance requires that and I will flag it.
- PO processing: we can accept emailed POs to ap@redwood.com or via your portal if it supports file uploads (PDF POs are fine).
- Card payments: for pilots billed to card we can set up usage thresholds to cap spend and granular project tags for chargeback.
- Marketplace: Vivek, can you confirm if our marketplace listing supports chargeback code propagation?

Next steps for Priya: if you can share the vendor portal link and the questionnaire, we will pre-populate our vendor record and upload the MSA for review.

Warmly,
Marissa Cole
Sales Operations, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com

Attachment: redwood_msa_draft_v1.docx (MSA draft, version stub)
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
To: Dana Lee <dana@orionlabs.com>, Logan Wright <logan@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 04 Oct 2026 10:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo recap + procurement checklist (PO vs card)

Hi all —

Quick technical note on marketplace and onboarding: 
- Our marketplace listing (AWS & GCP) preserves chargeback tags if your org passes cost-allocation keys in the marketplace subscription metadata. If you use the portal to provision, engineering teams can get billed directly.
- If Orion prefers direct vendor path (PO), we provide an invoice feed (SFTP or secure HTTP endpoint) and can support EDI-style PO matching for large-volume customers.
- For SOC2 evidence and the vendor questionnaire: we can drop a redacted SOC2 report into your portal or provide a signed attestation; let me know preference.

Next suggested steps:
1) Dana: please make an intro to Priya so Marissa and I can begin pre-population of the vendor portal.
2) Priya: if you share the vendor portal questionnaire link and preferred invoice format (PDF vs EDI), we'll upload the MSA and sample invoices.
3) Logan: I'll prepare a short one-pager comparing operational tradeoffs (PO vs card vs marketplace) to help Finance decide.

Thanks — looking forward to the intro.
Vivek Kulkarni
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
vivek@redwood.com
